  • Pits of Inferno Dragon Lair (here (32770, 32314, 12))
  • Dragonblaze Peaks (here (33149, 31269, 5))
  • Fenrock Dragon Lair (here (32587, 31380, 15))

Suggested optimized route for Server Save:

  • Bring a Vial of Blood, Vial of Oil, The Holy Tible, Orichalcum Pearl and Golden Mug.
  • Logout close to Pythius the Rotten and wait for 10 minutes after logging in to check in Fenrock Dragon Lair.
  • From there, go to Beregar and use Unlikely Pathfinder to go to Dragonblaze Peaks.
  • Then go to the Fire Portal from the Forgotten Knowledge Quest. Enter then Green Portal to go to Pits of Inferno Dragon Lair.
  • Go to the Knightwatch Tower and teleport to Darashia to go to the North Dragon Lair.
  • Unfortunately, there is no fast way to go to Goroma Demons, but you can walk back to Darashia and take the boat to Liberty Bay and then Goroma.

Behaviour

Each albino dragon spawn point has a small chance to spawn at exactly 10 minutes after Server Boot (not to be confused with Server Save), and then every 30 minutes after that. An albino dragon despawns 30 minutes after spawning, so do not wait too long before killing it.

An albino dragon attacks in melee range. An albino dragon will retreat at 1 to 199 (0.02% - 3.98%, deep red) health.

Strategy

Treat it as a slightly stronger Dragon Lord.
